message.content:
A joins "In exchange," cleanly at about 95 words. But it fabricates specifics: exclusive dashboards, "a hundred-plus pages of metrics," a basement. It also invents personal experience ("media relations I have seen since") and uses the anachronistic "SaaS."

B repeats "In," producing "In In effect," a broken join, at about 105 words. Its content is vague and repetitive, though it avoids fabrication.

A's fabrications are explicitly prohibited, while B's flaws are mostly vagueness and a doubled word. B also does address why PR worked: it acted as a reference when discovery was hard.
